profile.headline: Cloud Security Software Engineer @ John Deere | Software Engineering and Cyber Security Engineering Student @ ISU
profile.summary:
I'm current a Cloud Security Software Engineer on the Cloud Security Posture Management team at John Deere and a Software Engineering student at Iowa State University. My responsibilities vary, but at its core I secure our cloud environment with Python, AWS, and Azure, by building automation that checks resource configurations for compliance across our cloud fleet. I have hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, and GCP across security, infrastructure, and DevOps.

Outside of work, I build self-hosted and hardware projects on a Raspberry Pi 5, including:
• A personal website on a custom domain
• Dedicated game servers
• Network-wide ad blocking
• A prediction-market analyzer with a Discord bot

Next, I plan to pursue an M.S. in Cyber Security Engineering at Iowa State and grow into a full-time security engineering role building secure, scalable systems and developer tools.

positions.title: Cloud Security Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and deployed custom Lambda-backed AWS Config rules with cross-account capability across production accounts, evaluating recorded configuration types to flag and automatically remediating non-compliant cloud resources.
- Led the post-quantum cryptography readiness initiative across the enterprise cloud footprint, designing and deploying AWS Config rules that classify resource compliance by TLS security policy and assign ServiceNow CTRs to resource owners.
- Engineered a JavaScript IDE extension integrating Checkov to run static analysis on local Terraform files against
organizational cloud compliance benchmarks, flagging misconfigurations at resource creation time to prevent downstream deployment issues. It was adopted by 65+ engineers across ~40 teams.
- Built an internal MCP server that lets IDE coding agents query team specific documentation, using semantic retrieval across repositories to surface task context and ownership, for engineers to navigate unfamiliar codebases.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Python (Programming Language) and +1 skill

positions.title: Consultation Agent
positions.description:
- Consulted with clients to assess technical requirements and recommend tailored hardware, software, and service solutions aligned with client needs.
- Resolved a high volume of incidents by systematically troubleshooting hardware, operating system, and application issues, ensuring timely resolution and minimal user downtime.
- Acted as a Tier 1 IT support resource, diagnosing and resolving hardware, operating system, networking, and application-level issues across diverse consumer and small-office environments.

positions.title: Cloud Engineer
positions.description:
- Provisioned and managed Azure infrastructure components, including resource groups, key vaults, and cloud resources, configuring role-based access control to enforce least-privilege access.
- Supported cloud identity, networking, and security operations by validating Active Directory integrated DNS records, analyzing Azure Firewall configurations, and managing certificates for production websites.
- Developed Azure-specific automation scripts based on defined resource configurations to audit environments, enforce standardized tagging, and identify configuration irregularities across Azure resources.

courses.name: Application of Cryptographic Concepts to Cyber Security

organizations.name: Iowa State University Computer Science and Engineering Club
